summary.name: micro
summary.one_liner: Micro is a modern, intuitive terminal-based text editor distributed as a static binary with no dependencies.
use_cases: Editing files over SSH or in a terminal session
Quick code edits without launching a heavy IDE
Editing config files from the command line
Working with multiple cursors in a terminal
Running a shell alongside code in a split view
summary.what_it_does:
Micro is a terminal-based text editor that installs as a single static binary with no dependencies. It supports over 75 languages for syntax highlighting and ships with 7 default colorschemes, with support for 16, 256, and truecolor themes. Options are configured via JSON and keybindings can be rebound in bindings.json, with Lua available for deeper configuration. It offers Sublime-style multiple cursors, full mouse support (click-drag, double-click word, triple-click line), and a Lua-based plugin system with a built-in plugin manager. It can also open a real interactive shell inside the editor in a split pane.</what_it_does>
